info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Banking Operational Services Processing Order By Processing Order Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API allows consumers to access detailed information about a specific banking operational service processing order identified by its unique processing order ID. By leveraging this endpoint, developers can retrieve essential data related to order status, transaction history, and processing details. This can be particularly useful for financial institutions or businesses that need to monitor and manage their operational service transactions efficiently. Typical use cases include customer support inquiries and internal reporting on processing order performance.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the details of the specified processing order by its unique resource identifier. It provides essential information about the order status, associated services, and relevant timestamps.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the processing order details for the specified resource ID (RES-100045). This body must comply with the schema provided to ensure valid requests.

200.description: Request completed successfully and data retrieved.

GetBankingOperationalServicesProcessingO.description: This schema represents the request body for the Get Operations processing order. It is expected to be a string that may contain details about the operational services being requested.
